mapper.insert: MERGE INTO tea_cart USING DUAL ON (m_no = #{m_no} AND p_no = #{p_no}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ca_qty = ca_qty + #{ca_qty} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ca_no, ca_image, ca_info, ca_qty, ca_price, ca_del, ca_date, m_no, p_no) VALUES (tea_cart_seq.NEXTVAL, #{ca_image}, #{ca_info}, #{ca_qty}, #{ca_price}, '기본배송', SYSDATE, #{m_no}, #{p_no})
mapper.select: select c.ca_image as image, c.ca_info, c.ca_qty, c.ca_price, c.ca_del, p.p_name, p.p_price from tea_cart c join tea_product p on c.p_no = p.p_no where c.m_no = #{m_no}
